description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AcknowledgementJsonParser' which implements functionality to parse 'Acknowledgement' objects from JSON data. It handles extraction of various fields from JSON, validation, and conversion to internal representations, serving as a part of the acknowledgment processing in a messaging or communication system within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: AcknowledgementJsonParser
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a framework for parsing Acknowledgement objects from JSON, parametrized over an entity ID type that extends EntityIdWithType.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Implements the Function interface to convert a JsonObject into an Acknowledgement instance, extracting and validating necessary fields.

methods.name: tryToGetAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an AcknowledgementLabel from JSON, throwing a JsonParseException with detailed message if invalid.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Extracts the AcknowledgementLabel from given JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID from JSON based on the specified JSON field.

methods.name: tryToGetEntityId
methods.description: Parses a raw entity ID string into the specific EntityIdWithType instance, handling exceptions and invalid data.

methods.name: createEntityIdInstance
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to create an entity ID object from a string.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Extracts the EntityType from JSON object fields.

methods.name: validateEntityType
methods.description: Checks if the actual entity type matches the expected, throwing a JsonParseException if there is a mismatch.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Extracts and converts the status code from JSON to HttpStatusCode, throwing exception if unsupported.

methods.name: getPayloadOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves optional payload JSON value, or null if absent or null.
